Name: Brunette Claire Redone
Author: amongthem007
Description:
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12493]Brunette Claire[/url] by flyspies.The original mod just contain manual replacement so i decided to make Content Patcher version and edited it with my own recolor cause i like darker tones. Well, maybe just a bit different. And i added Nyapu's portraits too for those who loves it like me. You can choose between Original or Nyapu style in the config. There is seasonal variant which automatically enabled if you install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfit - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] by Poltergeister and config to enable NoNose too.

[b]CREDITS AND THANKS TO:
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]• Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] by FlashShifter and the team for making Claire. Yes, for making her.
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12493]Brunette Claire[/url] by flyspies for inspiring me making this mod.
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfit - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] by Poltergeister, Ailin, Tanpoponoko and all the team that make this beautiful mod.
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits SVE[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26601?tab=description]SEASONAL SVE CUTE NYAPU PORTRAITS[/url] by Nyapu, AhCuteArt and the team for making one of the most portraits mods i loved.
